answer: Random beacon audits with compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent anchors its identity to one slot: the beacon samples agents each epoch, and a chosen agent must solve a cipher challenge, proving live work. The trail stays crystal clear, so a silent or duplicate responder loses its slot. Forging 100 identities needs 100 live machines, about 100 x 40 coins, far above one reward. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
